game.title: Cell Biology: Cells and Division
game.description: An intro-college review of cell structure, the cell cycle, mitosis, and meiosis. Most questions are graded for accuracy; a few check in on how confident you feel.

questions.prompt: Before we start: how confident do you feel about cell division right now?

options: Very confident — I could explain it to a classmate

questions.prompt: Tap the organelle where most of the cell's ATP is made.
Prokaryotic cells lack a membrane-bound nucleus.
Which of these structures are found in typical plant cells but NOT in animal cells? Select all that apply.
During interphase, DNA is replicated in the ___ phase. (Answer with the phase's letter.)
In which phase of mitosis do sister chromatids separate and move toward opposite poles?
Put the phases of mitosis in the order they occur.
Meiosis produces two genetically identical diploid daughter cells.
How many chromosomes does a typical human somatic (body) cell contain? (Answer with a number.)
Which of these events occur in meiosis but NOT in mitosis? Select all that apply.
What is the failure of chromosomes to separate properly during cell division called?
In a word or two, which cell-division concept is still the most confusing to you?
Rank these topics from the one you feel most confident about to the one you feel least confident about.
